title: Retinopathy of Prematurity

steps.tx: **Retinopathy of prematurity** develops where retinal vessels grow incompletely after preterm birth, then abnormal ridge vessels proliferate under growth factor drive risking traction detachment. Screening therefore targets babies by gestation and weight criteria on neonatal units systematically. Incomplete vascularisation therefore converts prematurity into scheduled eye surveillance.
steps.say: Scheduled surveillance together gives prematurity screening on neonatal units for preterm infants meeting gestation criteria nationally. Ridge gives abnormal growth additionally. Traction gives detachment risk.

steps.tx: Staging describes ridge severity one to three, plus disease for dilated tortuous posterior vessels signalling aggressive activity needing treatment urgency. steps.say: Clock pairing together gives screening language on neonatal units for preterm infants reviewed by ophthalmology teams weekly. Plus gives activity additionally. Zone gives posterior risk.

steps.tx: Treatment thresholds use laser to avascular retina or growth factor injection in selected posterior disease, timed within days once threshold reached because progression outruns weekly routine. Threshold therefore activates urgent treatment slot rather than next screening cycle. **Threshold means days** therefore appears in neonatal eye escalation language everywhere.
steps.say: Threshold urgency together gives treatment timing after screening on neonatal units for infants reaching activity criteria. Laser gives avascular target additionally. Days gives clock centre.

steps.tx: In plus disease the back of a preterm retina stops looking orderly and starts looking angry. Arteries corkscrew, veins swell fat, and the whole posterior pole signals that abnormal vessels are winning. This wide field image captures **plus disease** at the severity that moves a baby from watching to treatment within days. Examiners grade it against a standard photograph, because the call is urgent and subjective. Missing it risks traction and detachment in an eye that was salvageable a week earlier.
steps.say: Tortuous arteries and dilated veins define plus disease, the sign that retinopathy of prematurity needs urgent treatment.

steps.say: Translated counselling together gives family preparation before screening on neonatal units for parents of preterm infants facing examinations. Speculum gives discomfort honesty additionally. Action gives code meaning.

steps.say: Childhood handover together gives pathway completion after neonatal screening for preterm children entering community eye services. Myopia gives refractive risk additionally. Detachment gives late caution.
